summary: Iteration 2: End-to-end tested Sales module + Barcode features (backend + frontend). Backend: 12/12 new pytest tests pass in test_sales_barcode.py covering (a) all seeded barang have valid 13-digit EAN-13 barcodes, (b) POST /api/barang without barcode auto-generates one, (c) duplicate barcode rejected, (d) GET /api/barang/lookup?code=<barcode|kode> resolves both (admin sees stok, employee response never leaks stok_sistem/minimum), (e) /api/sales/preview correctly buckets rows into ok/not_found/invalid (2 valid + 2 problematic of 4 rows), (f) /api/sales deducts stock from master (before-after delta == qty) and persists row in /api/sales list, (g) employee gets 403 on /api/sales and /api/sales/preview, (h) /api/my-tasks includes barcode field and never stok_sistem/stok_minimum, (i) all four summary exception sections include barcode key. Frontend playwright: admin login, nav-penjualan visible for admin only; SalesPage paste flow shows 4 preview rows with badges Valid / Tidak Terdaftar / Format Salah and counts '2 valid' / '2 bermasalah'; Simpan actually deducts stok_sistem of MNM-001 by 2 via GET /api/barang; sales-scan-add appends tab-separated line to textarea (verified repr contains real tab char); Master Data table renders Barcode column, creating item without barcode auto-fills 13-digit EAN-13 in db, form-barcode-generate Auto button also produces 13-digit numeric barcode; Barang Masuk scan input+Cari autofills kode/nama from barcode lookup; Rangkuman all 4 exception tabs (unchecked, out-of-stock, low-stock, discrepancy-items) render a Barcode column; Employee login: nav-penjualan hidden, task cards include barcode line, /api/my-tasks payload has no stok_sistem/stok_minimum, my-tasks-search by barcode filters cards to 1, and /api/sales, /api/summary, /api/barang all return 403 for employee.
critical_code_review_comments: gen_ean13 duplicated in FE (MasterBarangPage.jsx) and BE (server.py). Not a bug but consider relying only on BE auto-generation (leave FE Auto button using a shared endpoint or keep as convenience). Current behaviour is fine because BE ignores/regenerates duplicates.
SalesPage save() sends barcode || code from preview but backend accepts either; verified deduction happens correctly.
MyTasksPage title uses ASCII hyphen 'Stock Check - {name}', prior iteration_1 report claimed en dash — cosmetic only.
server.py at 804 lines — still monolithic; consider splitting into routers (auth/barang/penjualan/summary/my-tasks) for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Used seeded data. Test items TSTFE-* and TSAL-* / TEST-* were created and cleaned up during tests. Real stock deduction on MNM-001 (Air Mineral 600ml) by 2 units happened via UI test (was 125 -> now 123). MKN-001 also had 1 unit deducted via UI test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend lookup endpoint is GET /api/barang/lookup?code=<value> (accepts either barcode OR kode). /api/sales/preview accepts {raw: string} and returns {total, valid, invalid, rows:[{row, code, barcode, nama, qty, price, status, errors:[]}]}. /api/sales accepts {rows:[{barcode, nama, qty, price, tanggal?, catatan?}]} and deducts stock. Note: UI-driven tests decremented MNM-001 stock by 2 and MKN-001 by 1 — not restored (main agent may want a cleanup or re-seed if repeated testing needs precise counts).
rca of the issue: No bugs found; all 12 pytest cases pass and all 15 frontend assertions pass.
